Duplicated physical messages remain separate occurrences. Measurement exceptions propagate before later originals/reserve; no catch, default-zero or value key is introduced. assessments.topic: Adapter purity, scheduling and same-view binding
assessments.reasoning: Both producers are constructed and consumed inside the same existing submit_cpu_or_inline job, using the exact windowed/sent list before Host.project_source adds evidence. No added job, yield, I/O, buffer sharing or nested permit path. Unbounded target uses measured_bytes for the same former raw total; bounded target still uses declared capacity. Claude next then floor publication remains in its existing order. Production measurements use clock-independent Canonical_source string lengths, not Session_start age text.

Codex Start alone calls the new producer; Resume preserves its direct mechanical capacity step because it transmitted no history. Completion_review still bypasses Host range projection and remains unauthorized for Claude same-run shrink retry. Claude resume keeps its projection for working-state placement but suppresses carried-window/front observers. No retry, provider/request cap, source-origin or completion-review authority change.

Opaque measured_history is declared before the changed query signatures. Existing next/min callback+list signatures are removed rather than retained as compatibility overloads. Every discovered production/test consumer now constructs or receives measured_history. Tests that need only floor construct the same scalar snapshot; this adds suffix construction to those minimum-only test setups but no new production consumer path was introduced.

The occurrence test includes both signed zeros and the same positive message twice, verifies physical call order then constant reserve and that queries cause no further calls. The no-atom/error test includes a materialized preamble plus pinned row, verifies no extra reserve, then checks the original failure precedes reserve. The ownership test keeps a caller ref through a future opaque read across the initial collections, clears it, and keeps measured alive through subsequent weak checks/queries: a meaningful positive control by source inspection. These tests have not been executed or certified by this reviewer; callback-capture lifetime is supported by representation inspection rather than a separate executed capture fixture.
